name: Check Action
responsibility: In a team's CI, installs the published CLI, runs archboard check, and turns each finding into an annotation on the diff and a job summary
description: A composite GitHub Action that runs TypeScript directly on Node.js. It registers the extra checkouts named in its repos input, so a binding into an infrastructure repository reads in CI. A finding with configured-path evidence gets an annotation on both ends, the code and the manifest, each with an excerpt. The fail-on and allow-codes inputs decide which findings fail the job. A check that cannot run fails the job in every case.

outgoing.label: installs the CLI from npm and runs archboard check
